Maadi near modern Cairo'; 'Major sites include el-Gerza, Haraga, Abusir el-Melek, and Minshat Abu Omar'; Buto, Tell Ibrahim Awad, Tell el-Rub'a, Tell el-Farkha; 'replaced ... by the end of Naqada II circa 3200 BCE'; nothing in the Western Desert.
